canada.title: First Nations leader warns of consequences if B.C. repeals DRIPA
canada.summary: British Columbia's new Conservative government could face "dire" consequences if they repeal the Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act as promised, a First Nations leader said, adding that he's willing to work with new Premier Lorne Doerkson.

canada.summary: Protestors with Slopes Studio Creative Resistance, a Calgary-based artist collective, gathered at West Fraser's Cochrane headquarters to protest the forestry company's Crowsnest Pass operations with a large sign reading "forest butchers" made out of the same material used to flag trees for timber harvest.

canada.summary: Winter may need to check its watch after Winnipeg's first real snow of the season ranked among the latest measurable snowfalls the city has ever seen.

canada.title: Protesters call on provincial government to convert former Waterford Hospital into housing
canada.summary: Protesters stood outside the former Waterford Hospital on Sunday to call on the provincial government to take immediate action to address the city’s growing number of unhoused.

canada.title: Daughter hands out medals at Fredericton speed skating meet named for her father
canada.summary: Margot Joyce hands out medals at the Harold Joyce Short Track Speed Skating Championship, which her father started. Skaters from five provinces and one territory are in Fredericton this weekend.

canada.title: Arts groups in 'crisis mode' after lead contamination extends closure of B.C. theatre

canada.title: Montreal, Dorval aviation workers reject Bombardier’s final offer
canada.summary: More than 2,400 Bombardier Aviation workers in Montreal overwhelmingly voted in favour of a strike mandate on Sunday, rejecting their employer’s final offer.

canada.title: $200K from N.L. going to downtown St. John’s for private security foot patrols
canada.summary: On Thursday Newfoundland and Labrador’s justice minister announced $200,000 in funding to boost safety in downtown St. John’s, which is going towards uniformed foot patrols. Downtown St. John’s chair Jonathan Loder says it will act as a deterrent against crime.

canada.title: Historic N.S. lighthouse receives grants for repairs
canada.summary: Sandy Point Lighthouse, a 150-year-old landmark on Nova Scotia's southwestern shore, has secured federal and municipal grants to keep it from collapsing into the sea.

canada.title: N.B. cadet volunteers, parents push back as military halts flights, competitions
canada.summary: New Brunswick cadet volunteers and parents say a national funding pause has cancelled gliding and competitions, scaled back marksmanship and reduced paid training time for officers until at least March. National Defence says the program's budget grew to $265 million this year to meet rising enrolment and that weekly training nights will continue.

canada.title: Housing project in Brossard, Que., promised affordability. Residents said no

canada.title: Community groups blindsided as Ottawa pauses refugee sponsorship program
canada.summary: The federal government has quietly pressed pause on a program that helped community groups sponsor and support refugees come to Canada.

canada.title: How firearms regulations are changing the RCMP Heritage Centre
canada.summary: The RCMP Heritage Centre in Regina, which is set to become Canada's next national museum, has taken out all firearms on display in cases, to comply with provincial firearms regulations. Replica guns should be on display in the new year.
